thread:
maria (Marketing): Quick ask — prepping slide deck for next week's webinar. Can runtime run a compact 'microprobe' benchmark that captures cold-start + warmed p50/p95/p99 for our demo pipeline (chat -> embeddings)? We need something paste-ready for slides and a short methodology blurb.

devon (Eng: Runtime): We can. Quick clarifying Qs: 1) which model variants (FP16 / quant?) 2) input mix (short vs long) 3) warmup policy and concurrency levels?

maria (Marketing): Want both FP16 and 4-bit (if available). Input mix: 60% short user turns (~20–40 tokens), 40% long (context + user ~1k tokens). Include streaming vs non-streaming latencies. Minimal traces only.

ajay (Eng: Runtime): Do you need per-request traces or just aggregated metrics? Exporting full traces adds overhead to the microprobe.

sarah (Marketing Ops): Aggregates are fine for slides — p50/p95/p99, token throughput, one example coldstart trace, and a tiny CSV. No full raw traces.

devon (Eng: Runtime): Great. Plan: 10-minute sweep per variant, concurrencies [1,4,8,16,32], report p50/p95/p99, throughput (tokens/s), cold vs warmed windows, and attach one example trace and an artifacts README. Target ETA ~48h. Any other measurement constraints?

maria (Marketing): 48h works. Please include a short methodology snippet we can paste into the deck: sampling procedure, RNG seed, warmup steps, measurement window, and whether streaming was used. Also call out any caveats.

devon (Eng: Runtime): Quick config we'll run (for transparency):
```
profile: microprobe
duration_s: 600
concurrency_levels: [1,4,8,16,32]
repeats_per_config: 1
seed: 42
input_mix: {short: 0.6, long: 0.4}
models: [base-fp16, base-4bit]
collect_metrics: [p50, p95, p99, tokens_per_second, example_trace]
streaming: [true, false]
```
This will generate aggregates and one zipped example trace per run.

runtime-bot: job 9876 queued on runtime-cluster-us-east-1, estimated completion 46h.

ajay (Eng: Runtime): Note — 4-bit runs can be noisy on current infra. We'll do 3 repeats for quantized configs and report the median to reduce noise. We'll also compute variance so you can show error bars.

maria (Marketing): :thumbsup: Can you also run a small quality eval (40 prompt set) and report any top-1 similarity regressions so we can flag if quantization affects demo output?

devon (Eng: Runtime): Yep — we'll include a 40-item eval (same seed) and a one-paragraph quality note.

sarah (Marketing Ops): Please upload: 1) aggregated CSV, 2) PNG heatmap of p95 across concurrency, 3) README with column defs, and 4) S3 link in this thread when done. That'll let us drop numbers straight into slides.

devon (Eng: Runtime): Roger. I'll post the artifacts link and a short paste-ready methodology blurb here when runs complete.

maria (Marketing): Thanks all — this will make the webinar slides much cleaner. Ping me if you hit infra limits.
